result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I did not commit.

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6517). I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery, the same filter the quarterly, weekday and latest purchase-order queries already use. Ordering, zero-count reps and the warehouse-region match are unchanged.

**Verification:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (3 tests, 0 failures). The existing tests don't cover cancelled purchase orders, so I did not add a regression test for the example in the task. I didn't run the full suite.
